title: Asahina Mafuyu — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Thank you for helping me, Asahina.
You're a real lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm glad I could be of service.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
You should still have time to have lunch.
Please make sure to rest before afternoon classes begin.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, I will.
Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I hope the school store still has something available...)
Asahina, wait!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hinomori, Momoi, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, it's already lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Did you two just get here...?
Does that mean you had work this morning?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we were at a shoot for a TV show.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Weren't you on TV just the other day?
It's like I'm seeing you all wherever I go now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you.
But we're usually invited on as guests, so we're trying to make the most of each opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even when the cameras are squarely on us, we don't get nearly as much airtime as the other idols and personalities.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right. Being an idol sure sounds like hard work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But this is what we want to do, so we're willing to work as hard as we need to.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
That's very admirable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, Asahina, have you eaten already?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh...
No, not yet. I was helping a teacher just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Then, that's perfect.
Why don't we have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How does that sound, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, please join us!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind...
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Let's eat.
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank goodness the school store still had so many things available.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But your choices...
I mean, who buys a plum rice ball with an egg salad sandwich...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's because I thought I'd get hungry again if I only bought one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, Asahina, is that tuna sandwich going to be enough for you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I didn't have practice this morning, and I don't usually get that hungry after just studying.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really? If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That reminds me... We saw a few first-years talking about visiting clubs and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And it sounded like they already knew which clubs they wanted to join.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Most of the ones who came to visit the archery club picked up a bow and wore the protective armor for the very first time. But they seem eager to get familiar with everything as fast as they can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I saw that as well when I went to visit the other day. Their eyes sparkled with so much excitement.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminded me of when I first observed the archery club. It was quite nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nostalgic...? Wasn't that only two years ago? You sound like a doting grandma talking about her grandchildren.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A grandma...? I can easily see Hinomori elegantly sipping tea while sitting by a Japanese garden.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, how did you know?
I love having tea by our garden.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haha! I guess Grandma here can't really help it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Why are you two laughing?
Please tell me. I don't want to be left out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How do we explain this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, there's the bell...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we should head back to our classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us for lunch, Asahina. That was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's have lunch together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, let's.
